text.tspan: Nucleo-L476RG Arduino headers. J4: NC IOREF RST 3V3 5V GND GND VIN.
J5: A0 PA0, A1 PA1, A2 PA4, A3 PB0, A4 PC1, A5 PC0.
J6: D2 PA10, D3 PB3, D4 PB5, D5 PB4, D6 PB10, D7 PA8 (TIM1_CH1).
PWM on D2 (TIM1_CH3), nBRAKE on D7; Hall A/B/C -> D4/D5/D6 (TIM3_CH2, TIM3_CH1, TIM2_CH3 capture).
J7: D8 PA9, D9 PC7, D10 PB6, D11-13 SPI1, D14 PB9, D15 PB8.
24 V input, TVS, bulk + per-bridge decoupling
VBUS sense, CSA output RC filters
BLDC velocity shield: DRV8323S 1x PWM, Hall commutation in the driver, DC-link current
MCU sets PWM_MODE = 1x over SPI; INHA = PWM, INLA/INHB/INLB = Hall A/B/C, INHC = DIR, INLC = nBRAKE
